def runLengthEncode (s : String) (h_precond : runLengthEncode_precond (s)) : List (Char × Nat) :=
  s.foldl (fun acc c =>
    match acc with
    | [] => [(c, 1)]
    | (ch, cnt) :: tail =>
      if ch == c then
        (c, cnt + 1) :: tail
      else
        (ch, cnt) :: acc ++ [(c, 1)]
  ) []
